programs.title: Island Life 8
programs.desc: The program presents the stories of people who dreamed of living on an island, in a picturesque area, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. There are those who want a tropical climate and those who would like to live on islands in the Washington area and have a view of the mountains.Real estate agents will present properties in various price ranges to program participants.From those at an extremely affordable price to the most expensive and luxurious ones.Viewers will find out what the enthusiasts of island life will choose and whether their dreams will finally become a reality.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Pascal will visit Algeria - a culinary melting pot born from the combination of Berber, Bedouin and French cuisine.The journey begins in Algiers, where he learns about local delicacies and goes shopping at the oldest market in the capital.Use them to make an eggplant and meat apple pie.In the evening, in a confectionery shop with sweets, he learns what their secret is.Pascal's next stop is Bou Sada.The cook, together with Rashid and his family, prepares a traditional snack - sveti.Then he goes to the largest dromedary farm to learn the secret of camel milk.
